role: Goal decomposition via backward chaining through prerequisite chains in semantic graph
detail: Implements Layer 3 read-only goal-directed problem-solving by traversing REQUIRES, CAUSES, ENABLES, ACHIEVES edges in reverse (BFS) from a goal node to discover prerequisites. BackwardChainingExecutor.decompose(GoalDecompositionRequest) performs bounded backward BFS with confidence propagation using per-type degradation factors, cycle detection, and depth gating. Developmental depth progression (Piaget-style): Stage 1 max_depth=1 (5 successes to advance), Stage 2 max_depth=3 (10 successes to advance), Stage 3 max_depth=7 (terminal, hard ceiling). Returns GoalDecomposition with prerequisite_chain (list of PrerequisiteStep), is_complete (all prerequisites satisfied in graph), missing_prerequisites list, truncated flag, and A.19 SemanticInferenceTrace. Never writes semantic facts, only reads graph and emits trace metadata. Confidence formula: product(edge_confidences) * product(1 - type_degradation); minimum confidence of chain is overall_confidence.
gotchas: _find_prerequisite_edges remaps edge direction for caller convenience (swaps source/target for REQUIRES pattern so caller treats source_id uniformly as prerequisite); relies on MIN_CONFIDENCE_FLOOR filtering during traversal; _record_success writes gate state to graph via _persist_gate_state but this is metadata not semantic; if goal node does not exist returns empty decomposition with NO_EVIDENCE reason; cycle_detected flag set but only affects termination_reason if no chain exists (otherwise ANSWER_FOUND or DEPTH_LIMIT_REACHED takes precedence); trace writing wrapped in try/except that logs warning on failure.
